matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the NP-hardness proof in Section 2.1/Appendix A and Theorem 2.2, specifically flawed interval ordering assumptions in the reduction from ACYCLIC DIGRAPH PARTITION. Neither finding addresses this theorem or the NP-hardness proof; pred_id 1 discusses Theorem 2.3 (the PTAS), and pred_id 2 discusses Lemma B.3. Different locus per R1.

GT2 concerns the PTAS algorithm in Section 2.2/Appendix B, where overlapping intervals break the claimed guarantees. Pred_id 1 identifies exactly this: it quotes the passage from Section 2.2 that admits the PTAS is only feasible for 'limited and well-structured interval overlaps' and notes this contradicts Theorem 2.3's general claim. This detects the same defect—overstated PTAS guarantees that don't account for overlap complexity.
